messages:
olivia_fin: ping @tom_billing 	6 Argent Labs says their renewal invoice charged full platform fee on migration day. contract ARG-2022-051 had a clause to defer the platform fee until next annual renewal when migrating to Private. invoice INV-2028-0201-404 attached.

tom_billing: pulling invoice and contract. which amendment recorded the migration?

maya_csm: amendment AMD-ARG-2028-03 signed 2028-01-15, migration completed 2028-01-20. sales note requested platform fee deferral until 2028-11-01 renewal.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2028-0201-404 generated for ARG-2022-051 	6 $88,500. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-2028-0201-404.pdf

ryan_sales: sales confirmed internal approval to defer platform fee as a migration concession. CRM note says "defer platform fee to next annual invoice" but looks like the flag didn't sync to billing.

tom_billing: ledger shows Platform Fee (annual) $12,000 billed 2028-02-01. The amendment had a custom field platform_deferral=true in CRM but our Zuora mapping ignores that field.

olivia_fin: customer unhappy because they expected $0 platform this cycle. what's finance prefer: full credit memo or create a deferred liability and offset?

sophie_finance: prefer credit memo so customer sees a visible correction. accounting note: we'll reduce AR now and set a deferred revenue reclassification when the deferred charge is posted at renewal. need rationale and attach amendment. amount is $12k < $25k so auto-approve.

tom_billing: will create CreditMemo-CM-2028-0202-111 for $12,000 and apply to INV-2028-0201-404. I'll also add internal ticket to map platform_deferral flag to billing flow. posting ETA 30m.

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2028-0202-111 created for ARG-2022-051 	6 $12,000. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2028-0202-111-draft.pdf

maya_csm: I'll notify the customer and confirm portal shows the credit once posted. also looping legal in case contract language needs tightening.

tom_billing: Credit Memo CM-2028-0202-111 posted and applied to INV-2028-0201-404. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2028-0202-111.pdf

sophie_finance: please tag month-close journal JNL-2028-02-REV-DEF and use memo "platform deferral - Argent Labs". Eric FP&A will reclassify to revenue when the deferred invoice posts at renewal.

olivia_fin: thanks. follow-up: can we run a 30-day report for other migrations with platform_deferral flagged in CRM but missing in billing? cc @tom_billing.

tom_billing: will run report and post results to this channel by EOD. closing loop on this ticket.
